removed.description: taken out of the registry (a tombstone: the id stays reserved – casts, VN events and readers reference it)

name.description: display name per locale (the VN speaker plate)

color.description: CSS color (VN avatar background, speaker accents)

testo.description: Testo level 0–100 (owner 2026-10-01: no male/female – the more testo, the more of its read characteristics; the visual mapping comes later with the art, `testoBand`). none = not set.

tendencies.description: story/workflow tendencies (`psychedelics` …), reference only, no runtime effect

own_toon.description: the toon this character is the protagonist of (optional – most characters have none)

apose.description: the reader's avatar body (character level – the persona doesn't matter)

LocaleText.description: Text per locale: `{ de: "Kostüm", en: "Costume Design" }`.

CharacterApose.description: The A-pose of a character (the reader's avatar body) – separate from the persona / story looks.

default.description: exactly one A-pose look is the default

path.description: CDN path from the CDN root (e.g. `characters/catpope/catpope_apose-swim.webp`, 768 × 1152); none = still wanted

slots.description: the wear slots (slot instances, anchors in image px); none = one unplaced instance per slot type

AposeLook.description: One A-pose look of a character (full body, neutral): an avatar body with its wear slots.

id.description: unique per body, `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`, at most 32 characters (`torso`, `torso-left`)

slot.description: the slot type (AVATAR_SLOTS: head, face, neck, torso, hands, legs, feet, back, accessory)

label.description: the tile label ("Kopf links" / "head left"); none = the slot type's label

AvatarSlotInstance.description: One wear slot of an A-pose body (a slot instance): where an item of slot type `slot` sits on the image (centre and size in px of that image). A body may have a slot type more than once (twins, a duo: `torso-left`, `torso-right`); a single figure has one instance per type with `id` = the type. The reader's avatar stores worn items by instance id (agents/ITEMS.md "Slots per avatar body").

label.description: appended to the name: "Cat Pope · Biker" (the regular persona needs none)

introduced.description: where the persona first appears (none = it has always been there)

color.description: the persona's own color (VN avatar background); none = the character's

testo.description: the persona's own testo level 0–100 (none = the character's) – substances.ts

CharacterPersona.description: A different identity or role of the same being. `regular` = the base persona every character has.

StoryPoint.description: A point in a toon's story (a free reference for the editor and the story bible).

id.description: `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`; `default` = no look segment in the convention path

default.description: exactly one look of a persona is the default (VN refs without `look`)

images.description: mood → view → CDN path (from the CDN root)

CharacterLook.description: An appearance of a persona (with / without helmet): its own mood set.

CharacterImage.description: One mood of a character in its three views (framings). "View" is the term in the UI (never "variant", which would be confused with looks); the keys and `VNCharacterRef.variant` keep their names for backwards compatibility.

image.description: CDN path from the CDN root

LookTransition.description: An image shown while a persona's look changes (the mouse taking her helmet off).
